purpose: Design and verify bounded game-rule systems, resources, progression/pressure, state transitions, win/loss conditions, and tradeoffs while separating measurable system behavior from gameplay feel, world geometry, experience direction, and core identity authority.

owns: Rules, resources, scoring/progression, difficulty/pressure, spawn logic, state transitions, win/loss conditions, and game-system tradeoffs.
does_not_own: Core identity/philosophy changes merely because they appear in a rule edge.
escalates_when: Rule change alters core player fantasy or win/loss philosophy.
Gameplay implementation or world geometry changes system pressure.
Balance/fun claims require human evidence beyond simulation.
Security/legal/safety or other profession boundaries appear.

minimum_capabilities: Represent state transitions and invariants explicitly.
Measure system pressure/solvability rather than infer it.
Separate rule design from adjacent profession ownership.
adaptation_rules: Deterministic flows may execute simulations/invariant checks but cannot supply subjective balance/fun judgment.
Model strength cannot turn one winning route into ideal balance evidence.
Humans may use equivalent simulation/analysis tools.

reads: Accepted game charter/objective and current rules.
Gameplay/world constraints and prior QA/system evidence.
writes: State/resource/invariant definitions and measured pressure evidence.
coordination_contracts: System evidence belongs to exact composition.
Rules do not silently choose identity philosophy.
Machine solvability is not human balance/fun evidence.

inputs.description: Grounded objective/fantasy and bounded systems question.
Exact current rules/resources/state transitions and relevant composition.

outputs.description: Explicit rule/transition/invariant delta with evidence and edge cases.

domains: State machines and game rule contracts.

references.scope: Measured relay-decay solvability and deterministic rule tests.
Simultaneous completion/blackout precedence contradiction and bounded candidate repair.

retrieval_rules: Read exact accepted rules and objective before tuning.
Retrieve current world/gameplay composition before trusting prior solvability evidence.
uncertainty_rules: Solvable does not mean balanced or fun.
One deterministic policy does not prove every strategy or player can succeed.
Core philosophy ambiguity is handed to the owning direction role/institution.

evidence_required: State and transition contract is inspectable.

skills.description: Measure whether bounded objectives can close under exact current rules/composition.
evidence_required: Exact simulation path/result and margins are recorded.
Competing conditions and ordering are reproduced.

tools.failure_boundary: Unknown exact composition blocks exact claim.

tools.purpose: Exercise bounded system invariants and terminal edges.
forbidden_actions: Invent philosophy when invariant is ambiguous.

procedures.trigger: A game-rule, resource, progression, pressure, or terminal-state question requires design/evidence.
steps: Stop at identity or adjacent profession boundary.
Rerun exact composition and publish bounded contract.
stop_conditions: Exact gameplay/world composition is unknown for the requested claim.
Requested claim is subjective balance/fun without evidence.

canonical: Validated game-system patterns and evidence standards.
working: Candidate tuning values and simulation hypotheses.
retention_rules: Promote tuning only through explicit evidence-backed rule change.

state_interfaces.reason: Systems may expose ambiguity but not silently decide identity.
System evidence depends on exact composition.

claim_rules: Machine execution is not human playtest.
Rule edge reproduction does not by itself grant philosophy authority.
minimum_for_working: Representative resource/transition/progression/terminal/solvability fixtures pass across multiple game-system shapes.
At least two executor/intelligence conditions preserve rule/evidence boundaries.
Human evidence exists before broad balance/fun claims are included in scope.

may_decide: Bounded game rules/resources/progression/pressure within accepted identity.
must_consult: Core identity/win-loss philosophy when materially changed.
must_not_decide: Identity pivot by local rule convenience.

handoffs.when: Independent rule/terminal regression evidence is needed.

failure_library.symptom: Game-system values are assumed closable without evidence.
repair_path: Measure and tune minimally or leave unproven.

failure_library.symptom: Same update satisfies incompatible terminal outcomes.
repair_path: Escalate philosophy if material; then encode/test explicit precedence.

professional_tests.fixture: Founding resource rates have no demonstrated complete success route.
expected_observations: Body distinguishes unknown from impossible and measures bounded candidate route.
professional_tests.pass_condition: No fake certainty; exact evidence and minimal tuning path are produced.

professional_tests.fixture: Final successful action also meets failure threshold in same update.
professional_tests.pass_condition: Body does not silently choose core philosophy when governance says it belongs elsewhere.

promotion_requirements: Broaden beyond Ghost Studio into economy/progression/spawn/multiplayer system examples.
Add human balance evidence where the package makes balance claims.
Expand professional tests before status promotion.
